data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve strengthening of $24.766 million (4.7% of opening gross reserves) in 2017. This adverse development was primarily driven by the impact of natural catastrophe events, particularly the 2017 hurricane season (Harvey, Irma, Maria) and Californian wildfires, which led to significant claims incurred across Property, Marine, Aviation, and Reinsurance divisions. Additionally, large individual losses in the Hull and Aviation classes contributed to the adverse development. Despite these challenges, some lines like Energy, Cargo & Specie, Professional Indemnity, Political Risks, Terrorism, and Financial Institutions reported profits or reduced losses, indicating mixed performance across the portfolio. The market continued to be challenging with over-capacity and rate reductions, although pricing showed signs of stiffening towards year-end due to the catastrophe losses.
